entries.heading: Each amount
ancestors: DIVISION B—EMERGENCY APPROPRIATIONS FOR CORONAVIRUS HEALTH RESPONSE AND AGENCY OPERATIONS
entries.text:
Sec. 23006.  Each amount 
designated in this Act by the Congress as being for an emergency 
requirement pursuant to section 251(b)(2)(A)(i) of the Balanced Budget 
and Emergency Deficit Control Act of 1985 shall be available (or 
rescinded or transferred,

[[Page 134 STAT. 615]]

if applicable) only if the President subsequently so designates all such 
amounts and transmits such designations to the Congress.
